desc: Derive reduced row/column XOR constraints and prefix offsets for A/B tiles.
Implement fast input handling and parity DSU over H+W vertices with component count and inconsistency flag.
Implement row/column parity checks and B-cell union equations using prefix XORs of A tiles.
Validate against samples and edge cases (all A, all B, no B, parity failures, small brute force) and ensure O(sum HW alpha) time, O(H+W) memory.
